verdict.rationale: Sill's GitHub docs describe two-way clipboard transfer: text copied on the Mac is ready to paste on the device, and 'Paste in Sill' sends the device's clipboard to the Mac. The device-to-Mac direction needs an explicit action, and nothing in the evidence shows a way to turn clipboard sharing off. Missing for 10: a documented toggle to disable clipboard sharing, evidence on non-text content, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off

citations.quote: text you copy on your Mac is ready to paste on your device, and Paste in Sill sends what you copied on your device to your Mac's clipboard
